title: Route Sacred Time's hardcoded Color() literals through core/theme tokens
why: 13 raw Color()/Colors.white literals across these 2 widget files bypass core/theme/ tokens. The custom_lint rule meant to catch this (no_color_literal_outside_theme) is currently crashing repo-wide (already tracked elsewhere), so nothing flags it today. This mirrors a very widespread pre-existing pattern (406 raw Color() literals across lib/features/), so it is not unique to this feature, but each instance adds to the same cost: a future dark-mode or rebrand pass has to hunt literals feature-by-feature instead of editing one token file.
recommendation: Extract these into named core/theme constants, or explicitly document in coding-standards.md that the lock-screen's per-window-kind palette is an intentional exception to the theme system, once custom_lint is unblocked.
acceptance_criteria: Color literals in these 2 files replaced with core/theme tokens, or the exception is documented in coding-standards.md
no_color_literal_outside_theme passes for this feature once custom_lint is repaired
